description: This file defines a StatelessWorkerGrain class implementing a grain with methods to simulate long-running calls, gather call statistics, and manage activation information within an Orleans application.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerGrain
classes.description: A stateless worker grain class for Orleans, managing activation, call timing, and statistics.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic for the grain, initializing activation GUID and logging.

methods.name: LongCall
methods.description: Simulates a long-running call, logs timing and manages activation IDs.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Callback method for grain timer to complete the task.

methods.name: GetCallStats
methods.description: Returns statistics about calls, including activation ID, silo identity, and call times.

methods.name: DummyCall
methods.description: A placeholder method for a quick, non-operative call.
